messages.subject: singular information matrix
parts:
I generated a model with a structural part made by 7 relationships to which I added a regression. I used sem as to estimate models and "DWLS  as an estimator (variables are binary or have at least 3 response categories). Running the model, I had the following error messages:

Error in modificationIndices(object, standardized = TRUE, cov.std = cov.std) : 
  lavaan ERROR: could not compute modification indices; information matrix is singular
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In .local(object, ...) :
  lavaan WARNING: fit measures not available if model did not converge


2: In modificationIndices(object, standardized = TRUE, cov.std = cov.std) :
  lavaan WARNING: model did not converge

Thanks for the help.

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: singular information matrix
parts: >   lavaan WARNING: model did not converge

This is the problem: your model did not converge. You need to find out
why. Try with a simpler model, and then gradually add more complexity.

Yves.
